title: Why is the Solar System Flat?
summary: A minutephysics explainer on why the planets orbit in a flat plane. It shows how conserved angular momentum flattens a collapsing cloud of matter into a disk.
why: HN commenters link it as a quick, intuitive explanation of angular momentum and why spinning clumps of matter flatten.
topic: angular momentum and solar system formation
